name: 受動態使用頻度
description: 分析します the ratio and 分布 of 受動態 constructions, は AI text tends to overuse compared to 人間の文章.
useCase: AI生成テキストの検出 through systematic overuse of 受動態 constructions
mechanism: 識別します 受動態 constructions を分析することで auxiliary verb + past participle パターン and dependency parse structures. Computes the passive-to-active ratio per paragraph and its 分散. AI生成の text, particularly from instruction-tuned models, tends to use 受動態 more uniformly than humans, who naturally vary voice usage based on emphasis, stylistic preference, and information structure.
accuracy: 低-中 - 65-75% as standalone 特徴
source: Herbold, S. et al. (2023) - A Large-Scale Comparison of Human-Written Versus ChatGPT-Generated Essays, Scientific Reports
algorithm: Dependency Parse Voice Detection + Ratio Analysis + Variance Measurement
parameters: Detection method: dependency parse パターン, Granularity: per-paragraph, Metrics: passive ratio, passive 分散, passive clustering
strengths:
• Captures a known stylistic bias of AI systems
• Easy to compute and interpret
• Works well as part of 特徴 ensemble
• Consistent signal にわたる AI models
limitations:
• Low standalone discriminative power
• Academic and scientific text naturally uses 受動態
• Modern LLMs can be prompted to avoid 受動態
• Language-specific (mainly English)
